items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: With George Huck in them times. I used to use George Huckup.

ctx.x: And who were you playing with when you were at 512 Dolphin?

Well, I was playing with, I was playing with most of anybody. I had John Kazmi. I was playing with John. John Kazmi used to come over there and play with me over there. John Kazmi. There was so many of them fellas I played with. I know John Kazmi used to be my regular. And when I was over there I used to use Albert Giverell. With George Huck in them times. I used to use George Huckup. When I was playing violin. Love, when he first come here, I used him. Love. He come when he come from the country. I see.
